notes: Page shows only small, ambiguous 3D renders; piece identification is partly inferred from the parts list.
Steps 1-3: two dark gray Technic bricks, each with a round 1x1 brick on its side, joined side by side by a pin (inferred).
Step 4: black hinge plate and black side-handle plate placed on top of the two Technic bricks (inferred from the parts list colours).
Yellow sub-assembly: pin in a Technic brick, trans-brown curved brick on top; then attached to the step 4 assembly. Step 5 adds the dark gray curved brick on top.
The Dish 2x2 and other parts are not clearly placed on this page, so they are not included.

Page 2 builds two wing sub-assemblies (steps 1-4 in yellow boxes) and attaches them in steps 6 and 7. The right wing is a mirror of the left, using the Right wedge 41769 in place of the Left wedge 41770.

Part identification is inferred from small renders. Each wing is a black hinge plate under two 3x3 wedges, with a 3x4 hinge plate on top. A yellow 4x2 wedge, a yellow clip plate with an antenna, a yellow 1x6 tile and two yellow flags are added to each wing.

The white round plate appears only on the left wing. In step 6 the page 1 base (b1, b3) sits on the left wing's hinge plate b15. In step 7 the right wing is attached beside it; the hinge-to-hinge join b26/b15 is a guess.
A dark brown panel at the rear of the step 7 render is not clearly identifiable, so it is not included.
Not placed on either page: 3x lego-2540, lego-3794a, lego-4740 and 2x lego-4274.
The MCP servers claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive need authorization through the claude.ai connector settings. They are unavailable until then. They were not needed for this task.

The checker's 'lego-44567a x1 not in the list' is probably real. The list has only 2 lego-44567a, but b6, b12 and b23 all use that type. The black pieces under each wing (b12, b23), which the flags clip onto, are most likely lego-2540 side-handle plates, since a flag clip needs a bar. Under that reading, b12 and b23 should be lego-2540. I could not retype them because this reply only allows additions, so please retype them if the existing parts can be edited.

The missing inventory pieces (3x lego-2540, lego-3794a, 2x lego-4274, lego-4740) are not clearly visible in the two booklet pages' small renders. Their placement (b33-b39) is a best guess from the cover picture and parts list: handle plates on the wing hinge plates, the jumper plate on top of the base, pins in the second pin holes, and the dish at the rear.
If b12 and b23 are retyped as lego-2540, then b33-b35 would put the model at 5 lego-2540 against 4 in the list, so one of b33-b35 would need to be removed or retyped.
